description: Studio's default socket table. A new semantic type gets a socket by being
named here -- adding one needs no C++. A module that declares display{}
on its own type schema outranks this table; a type named nowhere falls
through to the trait rules below and then to `unknown`.
Entries take shape (circle | diamond | square | hexagon), fill, outline
and size; anything they leave out keeps the `unknown` entry's value.
